purpose: Define which KiCad ERC conditions are mandatory, reviewable, or waivable before any U1 schematic revision can pass G3.
scope: Applies to future component-bearing U1 schematic revisions. Does not retroactively qualify LEGACY-B1 or the zero-component U1-SCH-R000 scaffold.

legacy_b1_ignored_categories_observed: Global label only appears once in the schematic
Four connection points are joined together
Assigned footprint doesn't match footprint filters
baseline_observation.interpretation: Zero enabled messages is not a complete G3 pass while ignored categories exist. Each ignored category must be governed explicitly for U1.

policy.acceptance: KiCad ERC errors shall be zero. Any warning retained at G3 must have an individual traceable waiver with owner, rationale, affected nets/symbols, risk statement and verification evidence.
Every single-use global label shall either be removed/corrected or listed in the revision manifest as intentionally single-ended with interface rationale. Blanket ignore is not accepted for G3.
Every four-way junction flagged or suppressed by KiCad shall be reviewed for unambiguous connectivity. Ambiguous crossing/junction constructs are not accepted in released U1 schematics.

SPICE-model issues may be waived for symbols not used in simulation, but the waiver must identify the symbol and state that no simulation evidence relies on that missing/invalid model. Simulation-critical symbols require a valid model before the relevant analysis can be accepted.

Assigned footprints must match the exact selected MPN land pattern and project footprint policy. A footprint-filter mismatch cannot be dismissed merely because the board opens; exact package/land-pattern evidence is required for production-intent parts.
Power-input drive warnings must resolve through actual power-source semantics or deliberate PWR_FLAG usage with rationale. PWR_FLAG shall not be used to silence an unresolved power-path question.
Unconnected pins expected by the symbol shall be connected or marked no-connect with datasheet-backed rationale. Safety/fault/gate-driver/MCU supply pins may not be blanket-waived.
Driver/contention conflicts must be zero unless a component-specific datasheet-backed electrical reason justifies the connection and the waiver is recorded.
Hierarchical labels, sheet pins and top-level interfaces shall be consistent and traceable to the interface contract for the exact schematic revision.

CI must resolve every project and standard symbol/footprint library required by the revision without environment-only false errors. CI-only library mapping may be used, but the effective mapping and KiCad version must be recorded as evidence.

g3_required_evidence: exact MPN-to-footprint evidence for production-intent components
waiver_rule: A project-level ignored ERC category is not itself a waiver. G3 waivers are revision-specific, item-specific, evidence-backed and do not automatically carry to later revisions.
anti_hallucination_rule: Do not convert an ignored ERC category, a clean zero-component scaffold, or a clean legacy B1 run into a G3 PASS for a future component-bearing U1 revision.
